ios.desc:
Blink Helps You Capture Life’s Little Moments

Blink is a private micro-journal that helps you hold on to the small but meaningful parts of your day. Just snap a photo, add a thought, and keep your memories safe — no ads, no paywalls, no pressure.

Why Blink?
Life moves fast. Blink slows it down by turning your daily highlights into a personal timeline you’ll actually want to revisit.

Key Features:
Daily Blinks – Save one photo, note, or thought each day to remember what mattered.
Memory Recaps – Relive your week, month, or year with cinematic highlight videos.
Your Story, Your Way – Keep it totally private or share only with people you choose.
Clean & Simple – No feeds, no influencers, just a quiet space built for reflection.
Built-In Motivation – Gentle reminders help you keep the streak going without pressure.

Why It Works:
Research shows that reflecting on daily memories boosts happiness, strengthens relationships, and helps you appreciate the present. Blink makes it easy and now, completely free.

Don’t blink, these are the good old days.

By using Blink, you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:  
Terms of Use: https://getblinkapp.com/terms-of-service  
Privacy Policy: https://getblinkapp.com/privacy-policy

I missed what social media used to feel like, so I made an app to share real moments without algorithms deciding what matters.

On the Apple App Store only, sorry Android.
